projects.name: R-Value CRM
projects.description: Full-stack CRM platform for service contractors to manage operations, track job costs, and analyze profitability
projects.problem: Service contractors manage operations across texts, spreadsheets, and disconnected apps with no visibility into job costs, labor time, or profitability
features: Kanban pipeline with drag-and-drop status management
One-click lead-to-job conversion with bi-directional linking
Time tracking system (start/stop per job, worker-based)
Cost tracking with auto-calculated labor from time entries
Profit analysis comparing estimated vs actual costs
Full activity audit trail with system-generated notes
projects.architecture: Next.js App Router with TypeScript frontend. Supabase backend (PostgreSQL + Auth) with Row Level Security. Component-based architecture with strict client/server separation.
projects.currentState: Core CRM complete and E2E tested. Database schema stabilized with migrations. RLS policies configured.

projects.name: Production VPS Infrastructure
projects.description: Secure, reproducible platform for hosting web applications and services
projects.problem: Needed a secure, reproducible platform to host web applications. Managed solutions too expensive; manual server config too fragile.
features: Traefik config with automatic Let's Encrypt certificate management
Automated backup scripts for persistent data
security: Secrets in environment files excluded from version control
projects.architecture: Single VPS running containerized services behind Traefik reverse proxy. Cloudflare handles DNS, DDoS protection, and edge SSL. All infrastructure defined in Docker Compose.
